name: Strong dam break, a = 2.5
setup: Strong dam break: step from h = 0.75 to h = 4.5 (H0 = 2, a = 2.5), far outside training.
expect: Strong shocks form immediately. The network has never seen shocks, and the coarse mesh can only resolve them over 1–2 cells.
observed: NN alone blows up. MCL-NN survives, but q is poor near the shocks (26% error) even though h looks reasonable (4.3%).
